title: Cosmic Menagerie
description: A surreal cosmic scene centered on a cracked blue globe with glowing green core. A black silhouette woman with flowing colorful hair touches the globe while a black wolf with glowing yellow eyes and zebra-striped legs leaps above it. In the foreground, a bright green horse and dog stand together. The background features swirling colorful nebulae, multiple floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, and a human skull near the top.
